Description: Red sandstone gateway with marble inlay and the base of an ambitious unfinished giant minaret. Citations: Percy Brown (1942), 'Indian Architecture: Islamic Period'; J.A. Page (1926), 'An Historical Memoir on the Qutb (ASI)'.

Rubble fortification walls of Delhi’s second medieval city built to repel Mongol invasions. Citations: Peter Jackson (1999), 'The Delhi Sultanate: A Political and Military History'; Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'.

Stone tower with 225 holes used to display severed heads of executed Mongol prisoners. Citations: R.V. Smith (2005), 'The Delhi That No-one Knows'; Y.D. Sharma (1974), 'Delhi and its Neighbourhood (ASI)'.
